name: Primalist Tremors periodic chance, all cooldowns and one free cast
contract: One hundred first/highest Crash casts deal three/five periodic ticks; the independent check uses 1-0.9^ticks chance for at least one proc. A proc clears all four Seismic cooldowns. The ten-second cost buff includes Tremor, excludes Wildclaw and is consumed by one normal Seismic cast, including Grasp. Check baseline, talent removal and natural expiry.
